newsitem.title: CHINA: Dazhong Taxi signs rights issue for 49 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Dazhong Taxi signs rights issue for 49 mln shares.

text.p: Shanghai Dazhong Taxi Co signed an agreement on Tuesday with three brokerages for the issue of 49.1367 million new A and B shares to raise money to develop its taxi and coach business, the company said.
It said in a statement that the new shares, costing 4.8 yuan and $0.578 each, would comprise of 3.9 million A shares, 23.4 million B shares and 21.8367 million shares issued to state shareholders.
The total amount raised from the share issue will be 123.54 million yuan and US$13.53 million.
The lead underwriter is Shenyin & Wangguo Securities, and the international coordinators are Peregrine and Crosby.

Of the money raised from the issue, 60 million yuan will be used to buy 300 Santana 2000s. The rest will be sepnt on rental cars and large buses for use on the Shanghai-Nanjing and Shanghai-Hangzhou expressways, and to develop the company's tourism business.
